pages.text: Every vanilla body does something at 50%% sync:$(br)Moo: cow$(br)Rooting: pig$(br)Shed: sheep$(br)Spit: llama$(br)Sound the Bell: villager$(br)Barter: piglin (a gold ingot)
pages.title: Form 9-T: Tricks

pages.text: Warm Up: strider, on lava$(br)Withdraw: turtle$(br)Long Jump: frog$(br)Hiss: cat$(br2)At 75%%:$(br)Dash: camel$(br)Rear: horse, donkey, mule
pages.title: Form 9-T (2)

pages.text: Mend: iron golem (an iron ingot)$(br)Howl: wolf$(br)Treasure Sense: dolphin$(br2)Gold and iron come from your pockets.
pages.title: Form 9-T (3)

pages.text: Traits at 25%%: a sheep takes half fall damage; iron golems leave a villager alone, piglins a piglin. A strider walks on lava and a cat keeps phantoms off, as they always have.$(br2)A chicken sawn without a jar runs in circles where it was cut, never more than 12 blocks out.
